research.description: The research hut is available from founding. Assign a scholar, then codify the colony's first study — nothing advances until a mouth is spared to learn.
research.name: Research Hut

research.description: Knapped claws and better snares. Hunters bring back more.
research.name: Basic Tools

research.description: Woven gourds let a fetch-water trip haul far more per run.
research.name: Water Carriers

research.description: Moss-lined dens shelter another cat each without the chill.
research.name: Den Insulation

research.description: Elders teach which berries feed and which kill.
research.name: Foraging Lore

research.description: Raise the clothier and tannery. Fibre and hunt hides become cloth, leather, and warm clothing.
research.name: Textiles

research.description: Raise the Sägewerk. Felled timber becomes usable materials far faster.
research.name: Sawmill

research.description: Stacked stone stores. Every storehouse level holds more.
research.name: Masonry

research.description: Pitons, ropes, and cut switchback trails. Cats can finally cross the peaks — slow going, but the high ore is within reach.
research.name: Mountaineering

research.description: A proper forge-hearth for the ore mountaineering finally opened up. Raw stone off the peak comes back down as metal bars.
research.name: Smelting

research.description: Build the smithy. Metal tools open the path to weapons.
research.name: Smithy

research.description: Raise the barracks so cats can drill into real warriors.
research.name: Barracks

research.description: Build the school. Kittens sit and learn, feeding the research effort while they grow.
research.name: School

research.description: Dug channels feed the fields. Crops come in heavier.
research.name: Irrigation

research.description: Two-storey dens. Each den now shelters a small clan.
research.name: Timbered Longdens

research.description: Forge claws of iron. Warriors strike far harder.
research.name: Weaponsmithing

research.description: Hammered plate. Defenders shrug off blows that once felled them.
research.name: Armorsmithing

research.description: Sealed cellars and lofts. Storehouses hold half again as much.
research.name: Advanced Storage

research.description: A true academy. Research races ahead.
research.name: Scholars' Guild

research.description: Trained runners cover far more ground between waypoints.
research.name: Mounted Scouts

research.description: Stone halls. A single den now houses a whole lineage.
research.name: Grand Housing

research.description: Survey grades and draft rail blueprints. Physical tracks, rolling stock, and staffed routes are still required before cats travel faster.
research.name: Rail Line

research.description: Draft hull and dock blueprints. Physical vessels and staffed routes are still required before cats can cross open water.
research.name: Shipping

research.description: Raise the mill. Grain is ground into flour, then baked into food by the same staffed works.
research.name: Milling
